plain_english: Demo data for Northwind Bank, generated for this portfolio project with a fixed seed.

methodology: Last 12 full months plus the current partial month: 2025-11-01 to 2026-11-23
plain_english: Charts and tables open on this rolling window; tables can look back further.

methodology: Claims are assigned to the period (month, or week starting Monday) they were received
plain_english: A claim always counts in the period it came in, even if it was resolved later.

methodology: 12 CFR 1005.11: credit if not resolved within 10 business days of notice (weekends skipped; holidays ignored)
plain_english: If a claim takes longer than 10 business days, the customer gets their money back temporarily.

methodology: 45 days standard; 90 days for new accounts (opened <= 30 days) and foreign / point-of-sale transactions
plain_english: The deadline for reaching a decision.

methodology: Within 3 business days of resolution
plain_english: Customers are told the outcome within 3 business days.

methodology: Generic network rule: filed within 120 days of the transaction
plain_english: How long the bank has to dispute a charge with the merchant's bank.

methodology: A cohort month is mature when its Total resolved_rate >= 98%; a week is mature when every month it touches is mature; months older than the maturation table are mature
plain_english: Recent periods still have open claims, so their rates are not final yet.

methodology: SUM(numerator) / SUM(denominator) over the periods shown
plain_english: The dashed line and the table shading use a true average, not an average of averages.

methodology: Month: first day of the month. Week: the Monday that starts the week
plain_english: The period a row covers.

methodology: SUM(card_volume_daily.card_transactions) for days in the period
plain_english: Every card transaction in the period: the denominator for the claim rate.

methodology: SUM(card_volume_daily.card_dollars) for days in the period
plain_english: Total card spending in the period.

methodology: SUM(claimed_amount) for customer-favor claims
plain_english: Money permanently credited back to customers.

methodology: SUM(chargebacks.recovered_amount)
plain_english: Money won back from merchants' banks through chargebacks.

methodology: SUM(claimed_amount - recovered_amount) for customer-favor claims with no pending chargeback
plain_english: Money the bank absorbed as a loss.

methodology: COUNT(claims) by received date; transactions = COUNT(claim_transactions); $ = SUM(claimed_amount)
plain_english: Dispute claims customers opened in the period.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in claims
plain_english: Dispute claims customers opened in the period, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in claims
plain_english: Dispute claims customers opened in the period, in dollars.

methodology: Claims with current status Open
plain_english: Claims from this period that are not resolved yet.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in open_claims
plain_english: Claims from this period that are not resolved yet, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in open_claims
plain_english: Claims from this period that are not resolved yet, in dollars.

methodology: Claims with current status Withdrawn
plain_english: Claims the customer withdrew before a decision.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in withdrawn_claims
plain_english: Claims the customer withdrew before a decision, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in withdrawn_claims
plain_english: Claims the customer withdrew before a decision, in dollars.

methodology: Claims still open at the end of business day 10 after notice (weekends skipped), counted once day 10 has passed
plain_english: Claims that ran past 10 business days, so Reg E requires a temporary credit.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in pc_required
plain_english: Claims that ran past 10 business days, so Reg E requires a temporary credit, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in pc_required
plain_english: Claims that ran past 10 business days, so Reg E requires a temporary credit, in dollars.

methodology: Claims with a row in provisional_credits; $ = SUM(provisional credit amount)
plain_english: Claims where the customer received a temporary credit.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in pc_issued
plain_english: Claims where the customer received a temporary credit, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in pc_issued
plain_english: Claims where the customer received a temporary credit, in dollars.

methodology: Credit-required claims whose credit was issued by the end of business day 10
plain_english: Temporary credits that went out on time.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in pc_within_10bd
plain_english: Temporary credits that went out on time, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in pc_within_10bd
plain_english: Temporary credits that went out on time, in dollars.

methodology: Provisional credits with final_status = Made permanent
plain_english: Temporary credits the customer keeps because the claim went their way.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in pc_made_permanent
plain_english: Temporary credits the customer keeps because the claim went their way, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in pc_made_permanent
plain_english: Temporary credits the customer keeps because the claim went their way, in dollars.

methodology: Provisional credits with final_status = Reversed
plain_english: Temporary credits taken back because no error was found or the claim was withdrawn.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in pc_reversed
plain_english: Temporary credits taken back because no error was found or the claim was withdrawn, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in pc_reversed
plain_english: Temporary credits taken back because no error was found or the claim was withdrawn, in dollars.

methodology: pc_made_permanent + pc_reversed
plain_english: Temporary credits with a final decision.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in pc_finalized
plain_english: Temporary credits with a final decision, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in pc_finalized
plain_english: Temporary credits with a final decision, in dollars.

methodology: Claims with status Resolved - customer favor or Resolved - no error found (withdrawals excluded)
plain_english: Claims that reached a decision.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in resolved_claims
plain_english: Claims that reached a decision, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in resolved_claims
plain_english: Claims that reached a decision, in dollars.

methodology: Claims with status Resolved - customer favor
plain_english: Claims decided in the customer's favor.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in resolved_customer_favor
plain_english: Claims decided in the customer's favor, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in resolved_customer_favor
plain_english: Claims decided in the customer's favor, in dollars.

methodology: Claims with status Resolved - no error found
plain_english: Claims where the investigation found no error.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in resolved_no_error
plain_english: Claims where the investigation found no error, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in resolved_no_error
plain_english: Claims where the investigation found no error, in dollars.

methodology: Resolved claims where resolved_ts - received_ts <= deadline_days (45 or 90 calendar days)
plain_english: Decisions reached inside the Reg E deadline.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in resolved_within_deadline
plain_english: Decisions reached inside the Reg E deadline, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in resolved_within_deadline
plain_english: Decisions reached inside the Reg E deadline, in dollars.

methodology: Claims with at least one chargeback; transactions = chargeback rows; $ = SUM(chargeback amount)
plain_english: Claims the bank sent back to the merchant's bank through the card network.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in chargebacks_filed
plain_english: Claims the bank sent back to the merchant's bank through the card network, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in chargebacks_filed
plain_english: Claims the bank sent back to the merchant's bank through the card network, in dollars.

methodology: Chargebacks with network_outcome Won or Lost
plain_english: Chargebacks the network has ruled on.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in chargebacks_decided
plain_english: Chargebacks the network has ruled on, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in chargebacks_decided
plain_english: Chargebacks the network has ruled on, in dollars.

methodology: Chargebacks with network_outcome Won
plain_english: Chargebacks where the money came back from the merchant's bank.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in chargebacks_won
plain_english: Chargebacks where the money came back from the merchant's bank, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in chargebacks_won
plain_english: Chargebacks where the money came back from the merchant's bank, in dollars.

methodology: Customer-favor claims with no pending chargeback and recovered < claimed
plain_english: Claims where the bank absorbed at least part of the credit.

methodology: Disputed transactions on the claims counted in written_off_claims
plain_english: Claims where the bank absorbed at least part of the credit, counted by transaction.

methodology: Dollar amount of the claims counted in written_off_claims
plain_english: Claims where the bank absorbed at least part of the credit, in dollars.

methodology: claim_transactions / card_transactions
plain_english: Disputed transactions per 10,000 card transactions. Lower is better. Shown per 10,000 transactions.

methodology: resolved_within_deadline / resolved_claims
plain_english: Share of decisions reached inside the 45- or 90-day deadline. Higher is better.

methodology: pc_within_10bd / pc_required
plain_english: Share of required temporary credits issued by business day 10. Higher is better.

methodology: pc_issued / claims
plain_english: Share of claims that received a temporary credit. Neutral.

methodology: pc_reversed / pc_finalized
plain_english: Share of finalized temporary credits that were taken back. Neutral.

methodology: resolved_customer_favor / resolved_claims
plain_english: Share of decisions that went the customer's way. Neutral.

methodology: chargebacks_filed / resolved_customer_favor
plain_english: Chargebacks filed per customer-favor decision. Higher is better.

methodology: chargebacks_won / chargebacks_decided
plain_english: Share of decided chargebacks the bank won. Higher is better.

methodology: withdrawn_claims / claims
plain_english: Share of claims the customer withdrew. Neutral.

methodology: recovered_amount / credited_amount
plain_english: Share of money credited to customers that came back through chargebacks. Higher is better.

methodology: written_off_amount / claimed_amount
plain_english: Share of disputed dollars the bank absorbed as a loss. Lower is better.

methodology: Month the claim was received (YYYY-MM)
plain_english: The group of claims a heatmap row follows.

methodology: Claims resolved or withdrawn 0…6 calendar months after the received month; blank when that month is in the future
plain_english: How many claims closed in each month.

methodology: Mi_count / claims
plain_english: Share of the cohort that closed in each month.

methodology: SUM(M0..M6 counts) / claims
plain_english: Share of the cohort closed so far.
